title: Aug 11, 2022 · the Wallowa hailstorm
story: Hail 2.5 inches across and 4 injuries are on the public record for this storm near Wallowa (NWS storm reports; NOAA Storm Events, event 1053548). An NWS Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued at 3:21 PM covered the town of Wallowa, but not most of the Bear Creek drainage.
